design: The eight hypotheses preregistered in PRD section 3.2 before any of run 2 was built, decided from this run's curve, paired held-out verdicts, non-regression rows and quarantine report. A failed hypothesis is published as failed, beside run 1's.

rows.claim: the full Mend beats the frozen graph on the same held-out questions, every seed
rows.rule: full_v2 beats frozen on the same held-out questions at the last round under a two-sided exact McNemar test at p < 0.05, with a gain of at least 2.0 points, on all 3 of 3 seeds

rows.claim: neither random control beats the frozen graph
rows.rule: neither random control beats frozen under the same paired test on any seed

rows.claim: the plain-store arm is flat across rounds
rows.note: flat by construction: it is scored once per seed and cannot learn
rows.rule: the plain-store accuracy is identical at every round, for every seed

rows.claim: quarantine recall on planted wrong edges >= 0.7 with false-quarantine rate <= 0.1
rows.rule: recall on planted wrong edges >= 0.7 for every seed, and false-quarantine rate <= 0.1 where defined

rows.claim: net regressions on previously-correct held-out questions <= 2% per round
rows.rule: newly_broken / correct <= 0.02 in the worst round after round 0, full_v2

rows.claim: the held-out wrong-answer rate falls by at least 40%
rows.rule: the held-out wrong-answer rate falls by at least 40% from round 0 to the last round, every seed

rows.claim: gap-fill ingests most of what its own rule reaches
rows.rule: full_v2 ingests at least 60% of the withheld edges its own gap-fill rule reached, every seed

rows.claim: the run-2 update and gap-fill rules beat the run-1 rules on the same data
rows.rule: full_v2 beats full_v1_rule under the same paired test on at least 2 of the 3 seeds
